items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Hayward Walker? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: These might be the same guys that are in the picture, you see. Yeah. And what did Robert Carroll play? I was in the big trouble. Did you know Hayward Walker? We don't know if they were by the names of them.
Yeah. But they had nicknames I guess.
